record.edic_text:
2051 erizo {er-id'-zo}

from 2054;; v

AV - strive 1; 1

1) to wrangle, engage in strife
   1a) used to describe the calm temper of Jesus in contrast with the
       vehemence of the Jewish doctors wrangling together about
       tenets and practices
